notes.title: Update 11/6/2024
notes.content:
Version 2.1.2 - November 6th. 2024
-Fixed bug in "Cheater" ending that caused black screen softlock on restart
-Connected "Cheater" ending as a sidebar in "Dreamer" ending
-Adjusted dialogue in final cutscene to be flow better and be more coherent

notes.title: Update 7/12/2024
notes.content:
Version 2.1.0 - July 12, 2024
-Fixed bug in bedroom where two different versions of interaction with dresser were present
-Added version number to main menu

notes.title: Update 6/1/2024
notes.content:
Version 2.0.0 - June 1, 2024
-Added new cutscene/playable section to beginning of game
-Added more story to protagonist
-Adjusted parts of protagonist's dialogue to fit character change
-Changed tilesets for every puzzle to be different colors
-Made objects grey to make them pop compared to backdrop
-Changed gauntlet layout to be 5 puzzles long instead of 10
-First 3 puzzles are randomized, not in set order
-Avarhus only needs 5 crystals, not 10
-Removed teethbrushing cutscene
-Adjusted dialogue in cutscenes and object interacting to match changes
-Changed Anarchy, Backstabbing, Greed, and Insanity endings to fit continuity and logic
-Made game more replayable
-Added secrets
-Added cutscene to Dreamer ending
-Removed "Give Up" ending
-Changed "God Mode" to only let you select ending to experience/play
-Changed replay choice to skip puzzles available permanently
-Adjusted systems function to help game run better
-"New Game" only resets necessary functions instead of everything
-Adjusted design of playing card in Puzzle 5
-Altered locations and availability of a few crystals to make them easier to find/collect

notes.title: Update 1/22/2024
notes.content:
Version 1.2.0 - January 22, 2024
-Fixed bug in Puzzle 10-#2 where number dice could leave the mini-maze area
-Fixed bug where when trying to load save file after giving up the menu screen is still visible during text
-Adjusted conditions that control menu music based on what ending you've unlocked
-Fixed terminology and grammar in one of the ending cutscenes
-Added automatic movement to throne room to make game flow better
